title: Research Agents

h1: Research agents that gather and compare sources
overview: Research that takes hours, such as checking competitor prices, reading supplier pages or tracking industry news, can be handed to an agent. We build one that visits only the sources you approve, collects the facts you ask for, compares them and writes a short summary with a link back to each source, so you can check anything. It does not scrape anything a site forbids.

faq: Public web pages, documents, feeds and files you give it. We stick to sources you approve and follow each site's terms and rules, and we do not collect personal data in bulk.
How do I know the facts are right?
Every fact carries a link and a date, so you can click through to check. Where sources disagree, the summary says so instead of choosing one quietly.
Yes, from public pages in line with each site's rules. We do not break through logins or protections, and we do not resell data. Some sites may block automated reading.
Will it replace a person doing research?
It handles collecting and first-pass comparing, which takes most of the time. A person should still read the result and decide, especially before acting on it.
